rounds.literal: Umfana ushwiba izandla emoyeni, kanti phambi kwakhe kudlula izwi elenziwe ngamafu lingamnaki nhlobo.
rounds.story: Leli gama lisetshenziswa kakhulu uma umuntu engezwa noma engaboni ngamabomu lokho okushiwo abanye. Livela njalo ezingxoxweni zansuku zonke.

rounds.literal: Emhlanganweni wonke umuntu uhlezi kahle, bese kufika othile afake isigodo phakathi kwezihlalo, abantu badideke.
rounds.story: Lena inkulumo esetshenziswa uma kukhona ofika endaweni enokuthula bese kuqala umsindo noma ingxabano. Izwakala kakhulu emindenini nasemiphakathini.

rounds.literal: Inja ihlezi ekhoneni idlulisela ulimi ezibazini zayo, ibheke phezulu sengathi iyacabanga.
options: ukuzama ukuphola emva kobuhlungu noma ukwehlulwa
rounds.story: Lena inkulumo ivela esithombeni sesilwane esizama ukuziphilisa emva kokulimala. Namuhla isho ukuzelapha emva kosizi noma ukuhlulwa.

rounds.literal: Umuntu omncane ubhekene nesilwane esikhulu, asibambe phezulu ekhanda kanti uthuli luyandiza.
rounds.story: Le nkulumo ixhumene nempilo yemfuyo. Esithombeni sayo kukhona isibindi sokubhekana nento enkulu ungayizungezi.

rounds.literal: Ugogo ubamba uhlangothi lwekhanda lomfana aludonse kancane, yena enza ubuso obumangazayo.
rounds.story: Abantu abadala bavame ukuyisebenzisa uma umuntu omncane edinga ukulungiswa ngendlela eqinile kodwa enenjongo yokumfundisa.

rounds.literal: Emnyango kuvela unyawo lwesilwane kuphela, lonke lona lifihleke, abantu bebuka bedidekile.
rounds.story: Le nkulumo ithatha umfanekiso onyaweni lwesilwane. Namuhla isho umuntu oqina ngenkani angafuni ukuvumelana nabanye.

rounds.literal: Ingane ihlezi ithule, umlomo wayo ubukeka sengathi kukhona okuzifihle ngaphakathi njengenyoka emgodini.
rounds.story: Uma kuthiwa umuntu umunce okwakhe emlonyeni, kusuke kukhulunywa ngokuthula okuphelele. Isetshenziswa kakhulu ezikoleni nasekhaya.

rounds.literal: Iqembu labantu lihleka kuze kube sengathi amadolo ayanyibilika, omunye egoqa esiswini phansi.
rounds.story: Le nkulumo ayisho ukufa kweqiniso. Iwukweqisa okujwayelekile esiZulwini ukukhombisa ukuhleka okudlulele.

rounds.literal: Izingane zakha inqaba ngamacansi nezimbiza ukuze ihora lihambe ngokushesha njengomoya.
options: ukwenza okuthile ukuze kudlule isikhathi noma kunciphe isithukuthezi
rounds.story: Uma abantu bezama ukudlulisa isikhathi ngobumnandi, le nkulumo ivela kakhulu ezingxoxweni zansuku zonke emakhaya nasezikoleni.

rounds.literal: Umuntu ume phambi komngani avule ihembe, kodwa ngaphakathi kuphuma izinhlamvu zamazwi zikhanya.
rounds.story: Le nkulumo isetshenziswa uma umuntu esekhuluma yonke into ngaphandle kokuyifihla. Isebenza ezindabeni zobungani, zasekhaya nasezikoleni.

kids.literal: Umfana umi phambi kwendlebe enkulu efana nomnyango, eyigaxa ngesando, kuyilapho umngane ekhuluma eceleni.
kids.story: Indiva lihlotshaniswa nokungezwa. Uma umuntu enza sengathi akezwa noma engaboni, kuthiwa ushaya indiva.

kids.literal: Umfana ugxumela phezulu lapho izandla ezincane ziphuma ngaphansi kwetafula zibambe izicathulo zakhe.
kids.story: Le nkulumo isetshenziswa uma into ikuthola ungazilungiselelanga. Usala umangele ngoba ubungakulindele nhlobo.

kids.literal: Ekhishini, ugogo uxova amagama epanini, kufuke imisila yezinhlamvu emoyeni njengosobho.
kids.story: Njengokupheka ukudla ngokuxuba izinto, amanga nawo ayakhiwa kancane kancane. Yingakho kuthiwa umuntu uwapheka.

kids.literal: Inja encane ijaha umgijimi, idla kuphela ingxenye yangemuva yezicathulo zakhe.
kids.story: Uma umuntu ebaleka kakhulu, izinyawo zakhe zishesha kuze kubonakale sengathi leyo ngxenye isinyamalele. Kule mfanekiso kuvela le nkulumo.

kids.literal: Emhlanganweni wabantwana, othile ufaka into ende yokuhamba phakathi kombuthano, wonke umuntu esekhubeka.
kids.story: Into ende efakwa phakathi kwabantu ingaphazamisa ukuhamba kahle. Ngakho le nkulumo isho ukuphazamisa noma ukuletha udweshu.

kids.literal: Ikati elincane lihlala eceleni, lizicoca indawo elimele kuyo kancane, libheke sengathi liyaziduduza.
options: ukuzama ukuphola emva kokuhlulwa noma ukudumala
kids.story: Izilwane zivame ukuzinakekela lapho zilimele. Kuleyo mfanekiso kuvela inkulumo yokuzama ukubuyela esimeni emva kobuhlungu.

kids.literal: Umfana ulethe ibhakede phambi kowesifazane okhulelwe, elindele ukuthi ligcwale ubisi.
kids.story: Okumithiyo akukabi bikho ubisi bokusengwa. Yingakho le nkulumo isetshenziswa uma umuntu efuna into engenzeki.

kids.literal: Abantwana bahamba bedlula isiduli, umuntu ngamunye ephonsa idwala elincane phezulu kuso aze sikhule.
kids.story: Esivivaneni umuntu ngamunye ufaka elakhe itshe. Yingakho le nkulumo isho ukuletha umnikelo noma umbono wakho.

kids.literal: Isinambuzane esincane siwela ngqo endishini enkulu egcwele uphuthu, sibukeka simangele.
kids.story: Le nkulumo iveza umfanekiso wento encane ethola ukudla okuningi ingakulindele. Isho inhlanhla efika kungazelelwe.

kids.literal: Umfana ume phambi kwesilwane esikhulu esinezimpondo, kodwa uthi akukho lutho phambi kwakhe.
kids.story: Inkomo inkulu, ayifihleki uma iseduze kwamehlo. Yingakho le nkulumo isho ukuphika into esobala kakhulu.
